Prob035_count1to10.code:
module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic reset,
    output logic [3:0] q
);

    // Decade counter: counts 1 through 10, synchronous active-high reset to 1
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'd1;          // reset to 1
        end else begin
            if (q == 4'd10) begin
                q <= 4'd1;      // wrap from 10 back to 1
            end else begin
                q <= q + 4'd1;  // increment
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

Prob048_m2014_q4c.code:
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input d,
    input r,
    output reg q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (r) begin
            q <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            q <= d;
        end
    end

endmodule

Prob040_count10.code:
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    output logic [3:0] q
);
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'b0000;
        end else begin
            if (q == 4'd9) begin
                q <= 4'b0000;
            end else begin
                q <= q + 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

Prob056_ece241_2013_q7.code:
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input j,
    input k,
    output reg Q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case ({j, k})
            2'b00: Q <= Q;      // Hold state
            2'b01: Q <= 1'b0;   // Reset
            2'b10: Q <= 1'b1;   // Set
            2'b11: Q <= ~Q;     // Toggle
        endcase
    end

endmodule

Prob076_always_case.code:
module TopModule (
    input  [2:0] sel,
    input  [3:0] data0,
    input  [3:0] data1,
    input  [3:0] data2,
    input  [3:0] data3,
    input  [3:0] data4,
    input  [3:0] data5,
    output [3:0] out
);

    assign out = (sel == 3'd0) ? data0 :
                 (sel == 3'd1) ? data1 :
                 (sel == 3'd2) ? data2 :
                 (sel == 3'd3) ? data3 :
                 (sel == 3'd4) ? data4 :
                 (sel == 3'd5) ? data5 :
                 4'b0;

endmodule

Prob043_vector5.code:
module TopModule (
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  c,
    input  d,
    input  e,
    output logic [24:0] out
);

    logic [4:0] sig = {a, b, c, d, e};

    genvar i, j;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) begin: gen_i
            for (j = 0; j < 5; j++) begin: gen_j
                assign out[24 - (i * 5 + j)] = (~sig[i]) ^ sig[j];
            end
        end
    endgenerate

endmodule

Prob115_shift18.code:
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [1:0] amount,
    input  [63:0] data,
    output reg [63:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            case (amount)
                2'b00: q <= {q[62:0], 1'b0};                    // left shift by 1
                2'b01: q <= {q[55:0], 8'b0};                    // left shift by 8
                2'b10: q <= {{8{q[63]}}, q[63:8]};              // arithmetic right shift by 1
                2'b11: q <= {{56{q[63]}}, q[63:8]};             // arithmetic right shift by 8
                default: q <= q;                                // should not happen
            endcase
        end
        // If neither load nor ena is high, q retains its value (no change)
    end

endmodule

Prob100_fsm3comb.code:
module TopModule (
    input in,
    input [1:0] state,
    output reg [1:0] next_state,
    output reg out
);
    always_comb begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // State A
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; // in=1 -> B, in=0 -> A
                out = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b01: begin // State B
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // in=1 -> B, in=0 -> C
                out = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b10: begin // State C
                next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; // in=1 -> D, in=0 -> A
                out = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b11: begin // State D
                next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; // in=1 -> B, in=0 -> C
                out = 1'b1;
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = 2'b00;
                out = 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

                  (code == 8'h16) ? 4'd1 :
                  (code == 8'h1e) ? 4'd2 :
                  (code == 8'h26) ? 4'd3 :
